coin.definition: The basic currency, shown as a gold nugget. Spend coins to buy Item cards from the card row and to pay coin costs on cards and the research track.

compass.definition: A green currency token. Spend compasses to buy Artifact cards, to advance on the research track, and to pay compass costs on cards.

arrowhead.definition: A tan flint resource, spent chiefly as a travel cost to send an archaeologist out to a dig site, and on various card and research costs.

tablet.definition: A stone resource used mainly to research (advance up the temple track) and to pay tablet costs printed on cards.

jewel.definition: The most valuable basic resource, a red gem. Accepted on many costs and especially useful for advancing high on the research track.

magnifying_glass.definition: One of your two research markers. The Research action advances it up the left column of the temple track; it may never pass your notebook marker.

notebook.definition: Your second research marker, advancing up the right column of the temple track. Reaching new rows unlocks rewards and end-game points.

item_card.definition: Bought with coins. Played from hand for a one-time effect (resources, travel, card draw) and then goes to your play area for the round.

artifact_card.definition: Bought with compasses. Its effect triggers immediately when played, and many carry a lasting benefit and end-game value.

fear_card.definition: A useless card that clogs your deck, gained from unresolved guardians. It has a travel value but no effect; exile it when a card lets you.
